title: File:Exercise Dynamic Victory 2020 MOD 45167494.jpg
desc:
Picture Shows an Officer Cadet from Royal Military Academy Sandhurst (RMAS) climbing a stairwell on Exercise Dynamic Victory at the STANTA Training Area.
Exercise Dynamic Victory was the final confirmation exercise of the 44 week commissioning course; it tests the cadets suitability to become junior

title: File:Base demonstrates ability to respond, recover (4590993).jpeg
art: U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Katrina Brisbin
desc: A micro tactical ground robot removes a “bomb” in the restricted area during Exercise Panther View 18-3 July 24, 2018, on Buckley Air Force Base, Colorado. The MTGR is an all-terrain, stair climbing tactical robot used by the 140th Civil Engineer Squadron explosive ordnance disposal operators. (U.S.
